characters.summary: Speedy Gonzales relies on extreme superhuman running speed to outmaneuver opponents, steal cheese, and baffle slower foes like Sylvester the Cat. He rarely engages in heavy physical combat, preferring swift evasion and tactical pranks.
weaknesses: Low physical durability
Susceptible to traps if cornered in tight spaces without running room
limitations: Relies entirely on open space or paths to utilize maximum speed

sources.supports: Basic summary, personality, and signature speed abilities.

unknowns: Exact top speed limits in specific eras of animation.

characters.summary: SpongeBob SquarePants is an extraordinarily resilient marine sponge with bizarre cartoon physics manipulation, shape-shifting, and absorption abilities. He often fights with unconventional kitchen implements or sheer optimistic persistence, though he is typically naive.

mechanisms: Elastic physiology allowing attacks to pass through or deform him harmlessly

weaknesses: Prone to intense gullibility
Physical frailty when stripped of cartoon elasticity (drying out)
limitations: Needs water or moisture to avoid drying out completely over extended periods

sources.supports: Abilities, physical nature as a sponge, karate skills, and resilience.

campaignTags.claim: Can regenerate pieces of his body due to sponge anatomy

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his cartoon durability against reality-erasing attacks.

characters.continuity: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
characters.summary: Invincibubble is SpongeBob's superhero persona granted by a magic book, featuring the power to generate indestructible bubbles and incredible bubble-based offensive capabilities.
weaknesses: Vulnerable if separated from the magical book source or page that grants the transformation
characters.formDifferences: Transforms normal SpongeBob into a CGI superhero with bubble-shooting powers, super-strength, and an indestructible bubble shield.

sources.supports: Invincibubble form abilities, superhero powers, and bubble manipulation.

unknowns: Permanent duration of the transformation without the magic book.

characters.summary: Squidward Tentacles is an irritable cephalopod who prefers playing the clarinet and painting over combat. When forced into confrontation, he relies on improvised weaponry, sarcastic intimidation, or occasional bursts of unexpected competence.

mechanisms: Heavy doors and defensive enclosure in his Easter Island home

weaknesses: Constantly unlucky
Prone to severe physical trauma from slapstick accidents
Lazy and unmotivated to fight
limitations: Poor physical stamina and easily exhausted

sources.supports: Personality, anatomy as an octopus/squid, and recurring show tropes.

unknowns: Full potential of his artistic alters (like Handsome Squidward) in combat.

characters.summary: Stitch (Experiment 626) is a genetically engineered extraterrestrial bioweapon possessing immense super-strength, near-indestructible durability, multi-armed combat capability, and advanced tactical intelligence.
weaknesses: Water density prevents him from swimming (he sinks like a stone due to molecular density)
Sonic blasts can cause him disorientation
limitations: Cannot swim due to high molecular density
Prone to destructive programming triggers if activated

sources.supports: Genetically engineered bioweapon origin, superhuman attributes, and weaknesses like water.

campaignTags.claim: Uses plasma blasters and alien technology

unknowns: Upper limit of lifting strength when fully enraged.

characters.summary: Experiment 626 in his fully unrestrained destructive mode activates extra hidden physical features including additional arms, plasma cannons, and a hyper-aggressive berserk state.
weaknesses: Completely reckless and lacking defensive caution
Vulnerable to water density and sonic frequencies just like base Stitch
characters.formDifferences: Unlocks hidden anatomical features including a second pair of arms, dorsal plasma cannons, and unbridled destructive programming.

sources.supports: Description of Stitch's true function as a destructive galactic weapon.

unknowns: Duration of the uninhibited state before cooling down.

characters.summary: James P. Sullivan (Sulley) is a massive, incredibly strong furry monster who relies on raw physical might, roaring, and heavy wrestling tactics. Despite his terrifying appearance, he is naturally gentle unless provoked.

mechanisms: Thick furry hide absorbing blunt impacts

weaknesses: Emotionally soft-hearted
Lacks ranged offensive options

sources.supports: Monster physical description, top scarer status, and immense strength.

campaignTags.claim: Stands over 7-8 feet tall with massive bulk

unknowns: Exact weight and maximum lifting force benchmark.

characters.summary: Sylvester J. Pussycat is a persistent feline predator who attempts to capture prey like Tweety and Speedy Gonzales using cunning traps, claws, and pounces, though his plans constantly backfire due to slapstick physics.

mechanisms: Typical cartoon cat resilience to falls and explosions

weaknesses: Clumsy and unlucky
Easily outsmarted by faster or smarter prey
Speech impediment that often gives away his position
limitations: Consistently fails due to bad luck and poorly executed traps

sources.supports: Character habits, hunter nature, and classic rivalries with Tweety and Speedy Gonzales.

unknowns: True success rate if allowed preparation time without slapstick interference.

characters.summary: Tarzan is a human raised by apes in the African jungle, possessing peak human physical conditioning, expert tracking, knife combat, and exceptional mastery of arboreal acrobatics.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to modern firearms and advanced weaponry
Human biological limits
limitations: Limited against heavy armored or energy-based foes

sources.supports: Origin as a jungle-raised human, peak physical strength, agility, and combat skills.

unknowns: Feats scaling against various fantasy creatures encountered in deep jungle lore.

characters.summary: The Tasmanian Devil (Taz) is a voracious, whirlwind-spinning creature that destroys everything in its path with unstoppable rotational momentum, consuming objects and enemies indiscriminately.
weaknesses: Deaf to reason or strategy in a frenzy
Can be hypnotized or distracted by music or food
limitations: Lacks tactical intelligence or ranged attacks

sources.supports: Whirlwind spin ability, appetite, and wild nature.

unknowns: Upper limit of what objects can stop his spinning vortex.
